out.details: Proxies API requests to three backend services (core, BFF, SSE) via environment-configured rewrites matched in order; generic /api/:path* catch-all must stay last. Routes GraphQL/REST to BFF, long-lived streams to SSE gateway, others to core. Sets security headers (X-Frame-Options: DENY, nosniff, strict referrer policy) and allows images from MinIO, S3, and Unsplash.

out.details: Uses CI environment variable to conditionally set retries (2 on CI, 0 locally) and workers (1 on CI, 2 locally). Automatically starts Next.js dev server via `pnpm run dev` on port 3000 before test runs. Reuses existing server locally but starts fresh on CI. Executes global setup and teardown scripts from tests directory. Collects trace files on first test retry for debugging.

out.details: Supports six commands (extract, plan, generate, theory, render, check) to manage a documentation pipeline. Reads config from `scripts/docs/docs.config.json`, builds a code graph, caches summaries, makes parallel LLM calls with configurable providers (anthropic, claude-cli, mock), and syncs generated content into markdown notes without overwriting hand-written sections. Validates documentation freshness in CI.
out.purpose: CLI tool that generates, renders, and validates developer documentation from code analysis and LLM-generated summaries.

out.details: The concept graph is acyclic by design: structural edges only go deeper (increasing depth), preventing cycles. Dependencies are automatically discovered by analyzing file imports, following barrel reexports up to depth 5, and capped at configurable limits per unit.
